Claim 1 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle; and a second gradient member secured to said first gradient member at the distal end such that said second gradient member pivots at the distal end to the extent that said second gradient member is capable of an up position and a down position, said second gradient member defining a second surface, the second surface being structured to support the small vehicle, said first gradient member and said second gradient member defining a gradient between a ground surface and the bed of the truck when said second gradient member is at the down position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, the gradient being traversable by the small vehicle, said loading ramp being carried by the truck when said second gradient member is at the up position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, said loading ramp not limiting the storage space provided by the truck when said loading ramp is carried by the truck, __wherein said second gradient member is pivotally secured to said first gradient member by a hinge mechanism that allows said second gradient member to fold upward against said first gradient member when in the up position__.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, __wherein said first gradient member and said second gradient member are configured to nest together when said second gradient member is in the up position to minimize occupied space__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, __wherein said first gradient member includes support rails configured to support wheels of the small vehicle__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said mounting member is compatible with a receiver-type hitch __and includes a locking pin mechanism for securing said mounting member within the receiver-type hitch__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said support structure is adjustable such that the proximate end of said first gradient member is proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck regardless of the size of the truck, __wherein said support structure includes telescoping members that allow height adjustment of said first gradient member__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against a rear bumper of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, __wherein said proximate end includes a cushioned contact surface for engaging the rear bumper__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, __wherein said proximate end includes a lip portion configured to hook over an edge of the bed__.

Claim 8 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a plurality of beams.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a solid surface, __wherein said solid surface includes a textured anti-slip coating__.

Claim 10 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a porous surface.

Claim 11 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a plurality of beams.

Claim 13 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a porous surface.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said second gradient member includes a plurality of gradient members.

Claim 15 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 14 wherein said second gradient member includes a left gradient member and a right gradient member.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 15 wherein said second gradient member includes a center gradient member.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said first gradient member includes a first rail and a second rail running longitudinally between the proximate end and the distal end, said first rail being disposed opposite said second rail with respect to the first surface.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device moving said second gradient member between the up position and down position, __wherein said mechanical device includes a hydraulic actuator controlled by a manual pump__.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member locking said second gradient member at the up position, __wherein said locking member includes a spring-loaded latch mechanism that automatically engages when said second gradient member reaches the up position__.

Claim 21 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a beam secured to said first gradient member and said second gradient member.

Claim 22 (Previously presented): The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a chain secured to said first gradient member and said second gradient member.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a mechanical device, __wherein said mechanical device includes a cam-operated locking mechanism__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 __configured to support__ [[wherein]] the small vehicle [[is]] selected from the group consisting of a lawnmower, an ATV, and a snowmobile.
